screens.prose: We priced the put by matching two portfolios. Now we derive the rule for any $S_0$, $K$, $r$ and $T$, for European options on a share that pays no dividend.
screens.question: Put the lines of the derivation in order.

lines.text: A, a call plus cash that grows to $K$, pays $\max(S_T - K, 0) + K = \max(S_T, K)$
B, a put plus one share, pays $\max(K - S_T, 0) + S_T = \max(S_T, K)$
Same payoff in every state, and no cash in between, so the same price today: the law of one price
That cash costs $K/(1+r)^T$ today, so $c + K/(1+r)^T = p + S_0$
